bio: Situated in the Borough of Southwark and at the foot of The Shard, London Bridge Hotel is a 4-star boutique Hotel, surrounded by museums and art galleries.  Afternoon Tea is served in the stylish Quarter Bar & Lounge which features beautiful sash windows. Sink into a cosy leather booth or armchair, and enjoy a homely atmosphere while indulging yourself with delectable Afternoon Tea.  The Afternoon Tea includes an array of traditional finger sandwiches, homemade plain & fruit scones, and selection of delicious pastries. You can even compliment your Afternoon Tea with a glass of champagne or a sparkling cocktail.
